v2.answer: RAGAS is an open-source framework for evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. It uses LLM-based, mostly reference-free metrics to assess things like **faithfulness** (whether answer claims are supported by the retrieved context), **answer relevancy** (whether the answer addresses the question), and **context recall** (whether the retrieved context covers the needed information). It evaluates using user queries, generated answers, and retrieved context passages, and it can also use reference answers when available.
